name: Armor Glance
statusMeaning: Tried in the game with Kiln.
author: Xeonz
description: A compact, customizable armor display mod that shows your equipped gear with durability percentages and progress bars next to the hotbar  fully configurable via Mod Menu.
works: Each piece of armour worn, its icon and the durability it has left, beside the hotbar.
note: From Modrinth, unchanged. Not yet, as Kiln doesn't have them: the slot frames it draws around the icons (a texture: Kiln doesn't draw mods' textures yet) and its settings screen (Kiln doesn't show mods' screens yet). The icons and the durability left show fully without them
